chunks.say: My test runner ran a design skill's launcher, and it downloaded a seventeen megabyte binary.
chunks.cap: My test runner ran a design skill's launcher, and it downloaded a 17 MB binary.

chunks.say: A binary! From a design skill.
chunks.cap: A BINARY. From a design skill.

chunks.say: Phew, it stayed inside the sandbox.
I used to fix this by rewriting skills in my own words. That made my designs look AI-made.
chunks.cap: I used to fix this by rewriting skills in my own words. That made my designs look AI-made.

chunks.say: Now outside skills run as they are, with my rules in one place around them.
chunks.cap: Now outside skills run as they are, with my rules in one place around them.

chunks.say: Before. The job folder and the shared rules, like free tools only.
chunks.cap: Before: the job folder and the shared rules, like free tools only.

chunks.say: Options. Three, and a fresh judge picks one, with the skill names hidden.
chunks.cap: Options: 3, and a fresh judge picks one, with the skill names hidden.

chunks.say: Guards. Scripts run only in the sandbox. Nothing gets posted without my OK.
chunks.cap: Guards: scripts run only in the sandbox. Nothing gets posted without my OK.

chunks.say: After. Facts, links, accessibility and S E O. Never the style.
chunks.cap: After: facts, links, accessibility and SEO. Never the style.

chunks.say: So that launcher became one line in fixes dot M D. Banned by name, even dash dash help.
chunks.cap: So that launcher became one line in FIXES.md. Banned by name, even --help.
